title: Review sampling
asOf: Progress read at {{time}}. Refresh for current status.
successorReadOnly: Read-only source. Review this new revision separately in the project review workspace.
boundary: Sampling organizes reviews. Unselected and unreviewed submissions are not approved. New rework revisions enter the ordinary pending queue.
name: Batch name
perSubmitter: Round up separately for each submitter
visibleScope: Counts and sample rate cover only submissions visible to you; your own submissions are excluded.
progressBoundary: Approved and rejected count as reviewed. Superseded, unavailable and unselected items do not count as approval. Newer revisions do not change this frozen sample.
reviewUnavailable: Pending submissions are visible, but review is currently unavailable. Refresh to check access.
noReviewableItems: No items are currently reviewable in this sample. This does not mean every item is approved.
reviewSaved: The review was saved. Do not submit it again to refresh progress.
progressRefreshFailed: Progress could not be updated. Details were cleared; refresh to check current access.
savedRefreshFailed: Review saved, but progress could not be updated. Refresh this batch; do not repeat the review.
loadFailed: Cannot load batches. Refresh to check current access.
tooLarge: More than 1,000 candidate submissions. Narrow the selection.
previewFailed: Cannot preview. Check inputs, source integrity and current access.
changed: Candidates changed. Preview again before creating.
createFailed: Creation failed. Retry the same request or refresh to check access.
